source_refs.note: Exercise 3.4, Question 1: Exercise 3.4, book page 94: Q1-Q15 (integration by partial fractions); answers book pages 301-302

blocks.explanation:
Sab se pehle dekhte hain ke sawal kis qisam ka hai: ek rational function (polynomial upar, polynomial neeche) ka integral.
Denominator pehle se do mukhtalif linear factors \((x + 1)\) aur \((x + 2)\) mein toota hua hai, yani yeh Case-I hai.
Upar degree 1 aur neeche degree 2 hai, is liye fraction proper hai (division ki zaroorat nahi).
Plan: fraction ko \(\frac{A}{x + 1} + \frac{B}{x + 2}\) mein torenge, roots rakh kar \(A\), \(B\) nikalenge, phir har hissa seedha \(\ln\) ban jayega.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int \frac{5x + 7}{(x + 1)(x + 2)}\,dx\).
Maloom karna: yeh integral.
Tareeqa: partial fractions, Case-I (non-repeated linear factors, yani aise linear factors jo dobara nahi aate). Is poore fraction ka seedha koi formula nahi, lekin chhote fractions \(\frac{A}{x + a}\) ka integral hum jaante hain: \(\ln|x + a|\). Is liye pehle torenge, phir integrate karenge.

Partial fractions likhein
\[\dfrac{5x + 7}{(x + 1)(x + 2)} = \dfrac{A}{x + 1} + \dfrac{B}{x + 2}\]
Kyun: Denominator mein do alag linear factors hain, is liye har factor ke neeche ek constant (\(A\) aur \(B\)). Yeh bilkul ulta kaam hai jo hum fractions jama karte waqt karte hain: wahan do fractions mila kar ek banate hain, yahan ek ko wapas do mein torte hain.

Fractions khatam karein
\[5x + 7 = A(x + 2) + B(x + 1) \quad (1)\]
Kyun: Dono sides ko \((x + 1)(x + 2)\) se multiply kiya. Left side par denominator cancel ho gaya; right side par \(A\) wale fraction mein sirf \((x + 2)\) bacha aur \(B\) wale mein sirf \((x + 1)\). Yeh identity hai, yani har \(x\) ke liye sach hai, is liye hum apni marzi ki values rakh sakte hain.

(1) mein \(x = -1\) rakhein
\[5(-1) + 7 = A(1) + B(0)\]
\[A = 2\]
Kyun: \(x = -1\) par \(x + 1 = 0\) ho jata hai, is liye \(B\) wala term zero ho gaya aur sirf \(A\) bacha. Yeh "root rakhne" wala shortcut hai jo har linear factor ke liye kaam karta hai.

(1) mein \(x = -2\) rakhein
\[5(-2) + 7 = A(0) + B(-1)\]
\[-3 = -B\]
\[B = 3\]
Kyun: Ab \(x + 2 = 0\) hai, is liye \(A\) wala term gayab. \(-10 + 7 = -3\) aur \(-2 + 1 = -1\).
Dhyan dein: \(B(x + 1)\) mein \(x = -2\) rakhne se \(B(-1)\) banta hai, \(B(1)\) nahi; sign ka khayal rakhein.

Har fraction ka integral
\[\int \dfrac{5x + 7}{(x + 1)(x + 2)}\,dx\]
\[= 2\int \dfrac{dx}{x + 1} + 3\int \dfrac{dx}{x + 2}\]
\[= 2\ln|x + 1| + 3\ln|x + 2| + c\]
Kyun: Rule \(\int \frac{f'(x)}{f(x)}\,dx = \ln|f(x)| + c\). Yahan \(f(x) = x + 1\) ka derivative 1 hai jo numerator mein maujood hai. Constants 2 aur 3 integral ke bahar aa jate hain. Modulus isliye lagate hain ke \(\ln\) sirf positive number ka hota hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{2}{x + 1} + \dfrac{3}{x + 2} = \dfrac{2(x + 2) + 3(x + 1)}{(x + 1)(x + 2)}\]
\[= \dfrac{5x + 7}{(x + 1)(x + 2)} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Partial fractions ko wapas jama kiya: \(2x + 4 + 3x + 3 = 5x + 7\). Asal fraction wapas mil gaya, is liye \(A\) aur \(B\) sahi hain, aur integral bhi sahi hai.

blocks.text: Kitab ke aakhir mein answers (page 301) mein Exercise 3.4 ke jawab ghalat heading "Exercise 3.6" ke neeche chhape hain. Is sawal ka jawab us block ka item (i) hai: \(2\ln|x + 1| + 3\ln|x + 2| + c\). Yeh jawab sahi hai. Jis block par "Exercise 3.4" likha hai (page 301) woh kisi aur exercise ke jawab hain, is liye wahan se milane ki koshish na karein.
